column1: Apply the theme of magnetic flux to everyday physical scenarios, here are some conditions that can be added or expanded: 1. Introduce the movement of a conductive coil in a magnetic field
2. Place magnetic materials at the intersection of multiple magnetic fields
3. Set different geometric obstacles in a magnetic field
4. Apply a non-uniform magnetic field to a large area conductor
5. Introduce dynamic changes in the interaction of multiple magnets
6. Combine magnetic fields with optical elements
7. Simulate changes in the gap between the magnetic field and non-magnetic objects
8. Introduce the flow of liquid media in a magnetic field
9. Apply a magnetic field to deformable materials and observe their deformation
10. Introduce composite structures of different materials in a magnetic field
